Anna: FYI CI on main is red, snapshot diff in kvcache serialization for prompt_render_test. link: https://ci.example.com/builds/7812 :eyes:
Mike: got it — which job exactly? can you paste the failing diff or job id?
Anna: job 7812, failing shard 3. Diff is tiny but weird whitespace change in the serialized kv prefix.
Anna: ```
- "kv_prefix": "\n  prompt: hello"
+ "kv_prefix": "prompt: hello"
```
Sophie: that looks like an accidental newline being trimmed. did anything touch the serializer or the prompt normalizer recently? @Mike any PRs on that path?
Mike: I scanned recent PRs — there was a small change to json serialization flags in pr/2197 but it should be a no-op. can we rerun CI shard first to rule out flake? `ci-bot rerun build 7812 --shard=3`
ci-bot: rerun queued for build 7812 shard 3. started. :gear:
Anna: thanks. if rerun still fails, can someone bisect? this test is blocking a few PRs.
ci-bot: rerun finished — shard 3 FAILED (same diff). logs: https://ci.example.com/builds/7812/shard/3/log
Mike: OK I'll pick this up. quick repro steps for anyone:
```bash
# run the specific test locally with same env
export KV_SERIALIZE_FLAGS="compact"
pytest tests/eng/test_prompt_render.py::test_prompt_render -q
```
Sophie: also try the snapshot runner with deterministic seed: `SNAPSHOT_SEED=42 bazel test //tests/eng:prompt_render_test --test_output=errors`
Mike: last green on main was sha `a7c9d2b`. I'll start a git bisect from there and try an automated bisect run using `./scripts/bisect_snapshot.sh`. will post updates here.
Anna: perfect, thanks @Mike. ping me if you need test artifacts or to temporarily disable the golden to unblock merges. :thumbsup:
Mike: starting bisect now, ETA ~30m. posting results when done.
Sophie: nice — if bisect points to pr/2197 then we should revert or patch the serializer flags quickly.
Anna: noted. appreciate the quick turnaround everyone.
